response.rationale: Lesions present at birth with GLUT-1 negativity favor congenital hemangioma over infantile hemangioma, which typically appears later and is GLUT-1 positive. Kasabach-Merritt is excluded by normal CBC and lack of consumptive coagulopathy.

rejected.why: No thrombocytopenia or coagulopathy; ulceration alone is nonspecific.
GLUT-1 negative and lesions present at birth contradict typical infantile hemangioma.
